definition: to have the duty to deal with something
description: On a stone farmhouse terrace at sunset, a young woman in a pink wrap top and a cream midi skirt carefully carries a tall three-tier white cake decorated with pink roses on both hands, lifting one foot as a shaggy brown and white dog crouches playfully at her feet. She puts her foot down and stands still, smiling, while the dog sits and looks up at the cake. Behind her two young women in blue and lilac slip dresses dance under a vine pergola hung with string lights.

en.question: What is the woman in cream carrying?
